FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill SB249
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/08/2023
Senate Bill SB249 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of public K-12
schools by an undetermined amount to determine the eligibility of each student participating in
an interscholastic sport of the athletic association to which the school is a member. This bill will
not directly affect state funding.
